Comic text and bubble detector
Author: ogkalu
Source: https://huggingface.co/ogkalu/comic-text-and-bubble-detector
Upstream revision: 16e8a62
Model card license declaration: Apache-2.0; see MODEL-LICENSE.

Version 2.0 derives the bundled TensorFlow Lite graphs from the existing optimized FP32 model without retraining.
Files: litert/detector_optimized.tflite, litert/detector_backbone.tflite, litert/detector_head.tflite.
Input: float32 RGB NHWC [1,640,640,3], divided by 255. Outputs: class scores and normalized box coordinates.
Changes include static shapes, compatible integer indexing and layout rewrites, optional split FP16/FP32 execution, FP16 shader tuning and opt-in partial INT8 GPU matrix kernels. Trained source weights are retained.
Model hashes, precision choices and validation scope: ../TFLITE-OPTIMIZATION.json, ../TENSOR-RESULTS.json and ../MODEL.md.
Runtime: LiteRT.js (@litertjs/core) 2.5.3, Google, Apache-2.0; see litert/LICENSE.
